source.title: 112 - the EU's emergency phone number | Shaping Europe’s digital future

notes: 112 is the single European emergency number: free of charge from fixed and mobile phones in every EU Member State, and it works alongside any national emergency numbers (EU law: Directive (EU) 2018/1972, Article 109). Source: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32018L1972, retrieved 2026-09-26.
